description: Bundleable MNI-space atlases for contact labeling via affine registration. Each atlas is warped from its template space into the patient CT/T1 frame (see rosa_core.registration.register_affine_mi + the LabelmapAtlasProvider affine path), then sampled at each contact. Only permissively-licensed, redistributable atlases are listed here; non-commercial / all-rights-reserved atlases (FreeSurfer thalamic, AAL3, THOMAS, JHU, Morel, SUIT) are intentionally excluded and remain bring-your-own.

mni152_2009c_sym.name: MNI ICBM152 2009c Nonlinear Symmetric (T1w, 1mm)
mni152_2009c_sym.license: MNI / Louis Collins BSD-style permissive (redistribution + commercial use granted; retain the copyright notice)
mni152_2009c_sym.attribution: Fonov VS, Evans AC, et al. Unbiased average age-appropriate atlases for pediatric studies. NeuroImage 54(1):313-327 (2011).

mni152_2009a_sym.name: MNI ICBM152 2009a Nonlinear Symmetric (T1w, 2mm)
mni152_2009a_sym.license: MNI / Louis Collins BSD-style permissive (redistribution + commercial use granted; retain the copyright notice)
mni152_2009a_sym.attribution: Fonov VS, Evans AC, et al. Unbiased average age-appropriate atlases for pediatric studies. NeuroImage 54(1):313-327 (2011).
mni152_2009a_sym.provenance: Downsampled from the TemplateFlow res-1 (1mm) T1 to 2mm isotropic and rescaled to uint8 (0-255) to keep it small; intensity structure preserved for MI registration. The thalamus_mial atlas is on the native 1mm 2009a-sym grid and warps through the same affine transform.

cerebra.name: CerebrA
cerebra.long_name: Cerebrum Atlas (whole-brain): Mindboggle DKT cortical + manually-corrected subcortical
cerebra.coverage: whole-brain: 102 labels (51 per hemisphere) — cortical DKT gyri plus thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, accumbens, ventral diencephalon, basal forebrain, cerebellum GM/WM, vermal lobules, brainstem, ventricles.
cerebra.license: CC0-1.0 (public-domain dedication of the atlas data)
cerebra.attribution: Manera AL, Dadar M, Fonov V, Collins DL. CerebrA, registration and the human brain atlas. Scientific Data 7:237 (2020).
cerebra.provenance: Upstream CerebrA.nii is float32 (193x229x193, 1mm); bundled copy recast to uint8 (max label 102) and gzipped. Label values and the affine are byte-for-byte preserved; only the storage dtype changed. lut fetched from the same repo's CerebrA_LabelDetails.csv.

thalamus_mial.name: Thalamic nuclei (MIAL)
thalamus_mial.long_name: Probabilistic atlas of the thalamic nuclei (Najdenovska/MIAL) — 7 subparts per hemisphere
thalamus_mial.coverage: thalamus only: 14 labels (7 nuclei per hemisphere) — pulvinar, anterior, medio-dorsal, ventral latero-dorsal, central-lateral/lateral-posterior/medial-pulvinar, ventral anterior, ventral latero-ventral. Complements CerebrA's single whole-thalamus label. Contacts outside the thalamus read Unknown.
thalamus_mial.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (atlas data on Zenodo). ShareAlike: keep the license with the files; ship the labelmap unmodified except the dtype recast noted below.
thalamus_mial.attribution: Najdenovska E, Aleman-Gomez Y, et al. In-vivo probabilistic atlas of human thalamic nuclei based on diffusion-weighted MRI. Scientific Data 5:180270 (2018). Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.1405484.
thalamus_mial.provenance: Upstream MaxProb map (197x233x189, 1mm, MNI152 2009a nonlinear symmetric) recast to uint8 (max label 14) and gzipped; label values + affine preserved. LUT is the upstream Thalamic_Nuclei-ColorLUT.txt (FreeSurfer-format).
